name: convention-default-export-function
description: A default export that is a function is not an object literal, so the run ends with the convention-not-literal setup failure naming the configuration file and the property. The fixture assumes the analyzer carries a row named react-router for the package @react-router/dev, holding the installed version in its range, whose entry globs name root.ts below an app directory that defaults to app and that the appDirectory property of react-router.config.ts moves.
